name: Agent Audit Trail
summary: Immutable, hash-chained, Ed25519-signed execution logs with a forensic archive. The existing enterprise_infrastructure stack is the product.
description: Agent Audit Trail sells the hash chain and the signature, not a new logger. Each execution event is hashed to its predecessor, signed with Ed25519, and archived for forensic replay. Every action is attributable to an actor, a session, and a tool call. The chain is tamper-evident: break a link and verification fails. Exports are formatted for compliance review, not for a dashboard screenshot.
buyer: A team that has to prove what an agent did — to themselves, to counsel, or to an auditor — and cannot accept mutable application logs.

features.name: Hash-chained log
features.detail: Each event carries the hash of the previous event. The chain is the integrity proof.

features.name: Ed25519 signing
features.detail: Events are signed at write time. Verification is a library call, not a promise.

features.name: Attributable actions
features.detail: Actor, session, tool, resource, and outcome on every record.

features.name: Tamper evidence
features.detail: A rewritten or dropped event breaks the chain. The break is the finding.

features.name: Forensic archive
features.detail: Retention suited to investigation, not log-rotation convenience.

features.name: Compliance export
features.detail: Reviewer-ready dump: chain, signatures, timestamps, attribution.

source_components.maps_to: comprehensive_audit_logging.py — immutable trail, Ed25519, forensic context, chain of custody.

readiness.next_action: Sell. Pair with AUD-01 as the paid reconstruction of this trail.
